partners.title: My sell-staff
partners.intro: Shops and creators who sell your products. Approve them and set a custom commission — or leave blank to use each product's default.
partners.emptyText: Turn on “Open to sell-staff” on your products so others can find them in the resell marketplace.
partners.noneMine: You're not reselling for anyone yet. {link}.

market.title: Resell products
market.intro: Pick products from other shops, sell them in {shop} like a sell-staff, and earn commission. The supplier ships.
market.empty: No products open for resale yet
market.becomeHelp: Once approved you can add any of their resellable products to your storefront.
market.messagePlaceholder: Tell them about your audience, channels, and why you'd be great…

comm.title: Commissions
comm.intro: Commission is {pending} when an order is placed, {approved} when it's delivered, and {paid} once the supplier settles it. Cancelled orders are voided.
comm.emptyText: Add products to your storefront from the resell marketplace and share your links.
